scenario: asking for help with neighbourhood & directions
english_title: Recognising and Responding to Asking for Help With Neighbourhood and Directions
vietnamese_title: Giao tiếp nền tảng: neighbourhood & directions — asking for help with neighbourhood & directions
primary_communication_goal: recognise and respond to asking for help with neighbourhood & directions; complete the exchange naturally at A0 / Pre-A1.
context_note_en: Ms Lan tells Mr James she is lost and asks for help.
context_note_vi: Chị Lan nói với anh James mình bị lạc đường và nhờ giúp đỡ.

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.english: Excuse me, James. I am a little lost. Can you help me?
turns.vietnamese: Xin lỗi anh James. Tôi hơi lạc đường. Anh giúp tôi được không?

turns.speaker: Mr James
turns.english: Yes, of course. Where do you want to go?
turns.vietnamese: Được chứ. Chị muốn đi đâu vậy?

turns.speaker: Ms Lan
turns.vietnamese: Cho tôi đến chợ, làm ơn.

turns.speaker: Mr James
turns.english: It is just around the corner.
turns.vietnamese: Nó ở ngay góc kia thôi.
